text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
He mentioned that, as a Trainer, he was 
struggling to communicate with his 
Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, my friend? You look quite 
troubled. As a URA staff member, I simply 
can't look the other way.
choice_data_list:
I've been wondering how best to interact 
with my trainee...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I hear ya. But brooding too much won't do 
you any good. I've got just the thing for 
a change of pace. Come on!
choice_data_list: 担当の子との接し方に悩んでいて……
choice_data_list_en: I'm having trouble figuring out how to interact with my trainee...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Done splitting into teams? It's just a 
friendly rec match between the URA and the 
academy. Let's keep it casual!
choice_data_list: A change of pace... by playing soccer?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! In doing so, you can also train 
the stamina and endurance necessary for a 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: 気分転換って……サッカーですか？
choice_data_list_en: A change of pace... with soccer?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Talk about killing two birds with one 
stone. Alright, let's get down to it!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you, Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The ball came my way. What should I do――
choice_data_list:
Dribble past the opponent with sharp 
footwork.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (TWEEEEEEEEEEET!!)
choice_data_list: 勢いよくシュートを決める！
キレのあるドリブルで敵を抜く
choice_data_list_en: Drive in with a powerful shot!
Blow past the defender with a sharp dribble

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Yes! Nice shot!

text_block_list.name: Rookie URA Staff A
text_block_list.text:
All right, we won!! That last shot was the 
game-changer!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Good work out there. Going for the score 
in that situation took some serious guts!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
How was it? It builds stamina, and you get 
to mingle across generations and 
industries, right?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Soccer is an effective tool in Europe as 
well. As non-verbal communication, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Not just words, but personal space and the 
firmness of handshakes differ by country, 
though the rules of soccer stay the same.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
When dealing with someone very different 
from yourself, a non-verbal approach can 
sometimes be more effective than words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is quite a gap between <chrname> and myself. 
Perhaps using soccer as a means of 
communication could help break the ice...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Like I said at the start, this is just for 
a change of pace, alright? Though if you 
picked up on something, even better!
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます、勉強になりました！
choice_data_list_en: Thank you very much, I learned a lot!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Kgh...! She passed me!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
After them! After them! Don't let them 
score!

text_block_list.name: URA Staff A
text_block_list.text:
All right, that's a win for our team! Man, 
those were some impressive dribbling 
skills!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for that pass earlier! Because of 
you, I managed to sink the shot!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
How was it? It builds stamina, and you get 
to mingle across generations and 
industries, right?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Soccer is an effective tool in Europe as 
well. As non-verbal communication, that 
is.

Not just words, but personal space and the 
firmness of handshakes differ by country, 
though the rules of soccer stay the same.

from yourself, a non-verbal approach can 
sometimes be more effective than words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator

There is quite a gap between <chrname> and myself. 
Perhaps using soccer as a means of 
communication could help break the ice...
choice_data_list:
I'll try putting this into practice with 
my trainee next time!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Hope it goes well!
choice_data_list: 今度教え子と実践してみます！
choice_data_list_en: I'll try putting it into practice with my students next time!
